verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is open-source, dependency-free C/C++ that runs entirely on the user's own hardware. It loads models published as GGUF repos on Hugging Face, so models and local usage are not locked to a vendor and leaving costs little. However, nothing in the evidence documents an actual export path for user data such as web-UI chat histories or sessions, nor confirms that those data are stored in open formats. Missing for 10: documented export of conversations and settings from the built-in web UI and server, explicit open-format specification for stored user data, independent hands-on confirmation of data portability.
